title: Milwaukee Hackweek — Crew Expense Protocol & Travel Scratchpad
content:
Purpose: quick single-file reference for the crew (on-site leads + reimbursements) during Milwaukee hackweek. Use this as a running scratchpad for receipts, vendor calls, and day-of notes.

Pre-trip checklist (personal + admin):
- Book flights on company card — choose refundable fare if >$450. Flight lists to update Niko in ops.
- Hotel: Hilton Downtown (block code: REDW-0426). Confirm check-in name + split invoices for finance.
- Ramp: submit pre-approval if estimated expenses >$500 (meals + taxi + local AV).
- Per-diem: $75/day domestic. Meals under $25 still need receipt scanned for audit if not using per-diem.

Packing notes (crew-specific):
- Power strips (3), USB-C hub, HDMI cable, spare ethernet cable, mini HDMI->DisplayPort adapter.
- Badge printer password: localprint@2026 (confirm with vendor before deploy).

Vendor contacts (save these in phone):
- AV: Soundline Events — Marisol Vega, +1-414-555-0172, marisol@soundline-mke.com. Day-of onsite: ask for 1 backline mic and stage monitor test at 08:00. Payment: net 7; we pay via AP invoice to vendor@payments.
- Catering: Lakeside Catering — Tom Grover, +1-414-555-0289, tom@lakesidecater.com. Confirm vegetarian label and separate receipts per meal service. Tip included in invoice; request line-item.
- Local printer/wristbands: PrintHub MKE — Nia Sanders, +1-414-555-0134. They accept credit-on-delivery; keep paperwork for expense claim.
- WiFi/ISP rental: EventNet — tech@eventnet-mke.net, escalation: opslead@eventnet-mke.net. Ask for bandwidth SLA and test results by 06:00 day-of.

Expense rules & quick examples:
- Small purchases (rideshares, coffee) < $25: photo of receipt + Ramp tag = ok.
- Meals: use per-diem unless client-hosted meal — then itemized receipt required.
- Vendor invoices: forward PDF to finance@redwood.ai with subject: "Hackweek Vendor — [vendor name] — invoice" and cc ops@redwood.ai.
- Currency: not relevant (domestic) — if using corporate card in USD, no conversion. If international, use XE.com rate on date of transaction.

GL / category mapping (quick):
- Travel: TRVL-HQ
- Meals & Entertainment: MEE-TEMP
- Event Supplies / Rentals: EVT-SUP
- Contractor/vendor invoices: VND-AP

How to file reimbursement (step-by-step):
1) Upload scanned receipts to Ramp expense and tag with project: MKE-HW-2026.
2) In the description include: date, merchant, purpose (e.g., "Ground transport — crew to venue"), and approximate attendee list if shared.
3) Add expense category and attach any vendor invoices.
4) Hit submit and ping #hackweek-finance in Slack with the expense link and "urgent" if you need same-day cash back.
5) For vendor invoices, request PO from procurement team (procurement@) before approving payment.

Day-of operations quick hits:
- Arrival window for load-in: 06:00–09:00. Gate code for service entrance: 4721# (confirm day-of with venue).
- AV check: schedule walk-through at 07:30 with Marisol. Bring spare mic battery pack.
- Catering drop: 09:00 — confirm staging area and allergen table.
- Receipts: designate one envelope per vendor labeled with vendor name + contact and hand to on-site admin at 17:30.

Templates / short messages to send: 
- To ops: "Heads-up: Hilton block OK. Sending final attendee list by EOD 3/10. Need confirmation on split invoice. — Ava"
- To finance (when urgent): "Ramp expense submitted: [link]. Tag: MKE-HW-2026. Please expedite for petty cash reimbursement."

Notes to self / open items:
- Confirm badge count with PrintHub (Nia) — we may need 150 not 120.
- Confirm whether venue will accept split payment for AV; if not, route through AP.
- Check whether vendors need W9 on file — ask procurement.

Post-event wrap (what I do immediately):
- Collect all envelopes, photograph each invoice/receipt, upload to Ramp and to shared drive folder (confluence link above).
- Quick expense reconciliation: create one sheet with date, payee, amount, GL code, attached file link, submitted_by. Share with Diego for signoff.
- Add vendor feedback to the Confluence page (AV + Catering performance notes).

Quick reference (phone numbers + short):
- On-site lead: Diego Morales +1-206-555-0199
- Ops escalations: Priya Singh +1-415-555-0122
- Finance emergency: Tara Lee +1-650-555-0147 (text first)

Final reminders:
- Get all itemized receipts for catering and AV (required for vendor expense category).
- If any meal >$75 split with team and annotate attendees.
- Keep one paper copy of every invoice in the event binder.

Scratchpad entries (use during trip):
- 2026-03-12 07:22: Taxi to hotel $36.50 (receipt photo: IMG_001.jpg)
- 2026-03-12 12:05: Lunch with crew $210.42 (submitted as per-diem)
- 2026-03-13 08:45: Printer pickup $48.00 (vendor: PrintHub)

End of doc — overwrite this file during the event with live notes and receipt filenames. Keep it synced with the shared confluence page and #hackweek Slack channel for transparency.
